HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 2
Series Seed Preferred Stock: summary of terms, signed May 9, 2011
Investor: Alder Peak Ventures, L.P. Amount: $1,482,637.50 for 395,370 shares.
Price per share: $3.75. Pre-money valuation: $5,662,856.25, fully diluted, counting
the option pool and the shares issued on note conversion.
Liquidation preference: one times the purchase price, non-participating.
Conversion: one to one into common stock, at the holder's option.
Board: three seats. Jane Doe, Richard Roe and one director named by Alder Peak, who
will be Mark Moe.

HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 2 of 2
Protective provisions: the investor's consent is needed to change the charter, issue
senior stock or sell the company.
Pro rata rights: the investor may keep its percentage in later rounds.
No-shop: 30 days from signing.
Investor counsel fees: paid by the company, capped at $25,000.
Target closing: on or before June 30, 2011.
Except for the no-shop and confidentiality terms, this summary is not binding.
